prompt: ONE original separate1024x1024 square pure artwork for WAXWAKE. TIDE CRADLE: a squat asymmetrical six-sided batik island, broad and compact, divided into FOUR large irregular muted-TEAL reservoirs by thick cream and ochre reserved walls; one reservoir is turned INSIDE OUT so its indigo centre extends beyond the outer border in a short hooked tongue. Indigo #122E5C, ochre #C48C35, cream #F3E2BC, rust #A54832 and teal #4E8B87. No stitched applique, embroidery, raised relief, plush or3D material. Whole irregular textile edge central65% with18% genuine transparent alpha margin; dyed internal fields opaque, exterior transparent. Flat textile scan, no sheet/backdrop, tile, floor, frame or stand.
